notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Version number: V1.0.2
Update Date: 4.30.2025
Update content:
[olist]
[*]The reward effect of adding a points mechanism on the turn based settlement page.
[*]The game has added a "treasure box mechanism". And in battle, monster drops increase the chance of dropping treasure chests.
[*]Fix other bugs.
[/olist]
